assignment.preferred_cook: the household's favourite, drawn once per seed uniformly among the kitchens whose skills cover its tiffin; matching.preferred_first before the solver
assignment.gini_population: kitchens eligible on at least one evening of the scored week
assignment.cost_population: the scored week's orders that every arm (greedy and every λ) assigned, the preferred cooks' included
assignment.pairing: a seed is dropped when CP-SAT fell back to greedy on any evening of any week at any λ; an order no kitchen in reach has room for is left out, as production refunds it (ADR-0027), and each arm reports the share it left out (unassigned_share); the arms may leave out different orders, hence the cost over the orders every arm assigned
assignment.request: matching.solver_request, the builder production's round uses

settings.societies: the seed societies with a hub (boundary centre), then uniform random points in the area, not snapped to roads
settings.fleet: ceil(1.5 x crates / capacity_crates), at most 60
settings.matrix: haversine x 1.3 at 6.0 m/s (routing.haversine_matrix), times the vans' traffic factor

50.rule: over >= 5 seeds: the plan's on-time 95 % CI lower bound >= 0.95, the per-seed paired cost_plan / cost_nn - 1 (per served order) 95 % CI upper bound <= -0.10, every plan the solver's with no checker problem; guardrail: the time limit a wave <= 10 s (the solver spends it; the wall time over it is the overhead); the shorter budget is evidence, reference only

acceptance_over_greedy.rule: paired difference vs greedy: 95 % CI above 0

acceptance_over_random.rule: paired difference vs random: 95 % CI above 0

verdict.rule: acceptance ≥ 0.70 and above greedy and random (paired CI), hard rules kept

v2_acceptance_over_v1_all_weeks.rule: reference: weeks < 2 are identical by construction

v2_acceptance_over_v1.rule: paired difference vs cpsat, weeks ≥ 2: 95 % CI lower bound ≥ 0

v2_perishables_within_1_of_v1.rule: mean paired difference in distinct perishables, weeks ≥ 2: ≤ +1

v2_verdict.rule: acceptance not below v1 (paired CI lower bound ≥ 0, weeks ≥ 2), hard rules kept, perishables ≤ v1 + 1; no verdict below 5 paired seeds

pantry.metric: quantity MAE as a share of weekly quantity (sum |error| / sum actual per household item, zero weeks kept; mean over items)

gini_le_0_25_at_le_5pct_cost.rule: per-seed paired: 95 % CI upper bounds of cost_λ / cost_greedy - 1 ≤ 0.05 and of the weekly Gini ≤ 0.25, λ > 0
gini_le_0_25_at_le_5pct_cost.lambda_rule: the target holds: the smallest λ > 0 that meets it (§4); it does not: the mean-cost budget rule, the largest λ > 0 of the grid up to which every λ > 0 keeps the mean cost against greedy ≤ +5 %, else 300 (§7, 2026-11-01)

gap_to_seasonal_naive_ge_0_10.rule: seasonal naive WAPE - champion WAPE, paired 95 % CI lower bound ≥ 0.10

seasonal_naive.rule: champion - seasonal_naive newsvendor cost, paired 95 % CI upper bound < 0

naive.rule: champion - naive newsvendor cost, paired 95 % CI upper bound < 0

targets.note: Not judged (eval protocol §7, 2026-11-02): at the registered costs (C_u 0.3, C_o 0.5) tau = 0.375, so q_tau sits below the median by design and about 1 - tau of the points stock out; the registered stock-out ≤ 3 % contradicts those costs. The costs are kept; the M-E target is judged on WAPE and the gap to seasonal naive, and the newsvendor cost against both baselines answers RQ3 beside it.

settings.data: the simulator in memory, as train_ranker's snapshot rows (eval/ranker_eval.py)
settings.cutoff: orders.api.cutoff_for (21:00 IST the day before delivery)
settings.trainer: jobs.train_ranker.fit (ranker.train defaults: 200 rounds, seed 7, 1 thread, deterministic)
settings.serving: own past items (frequency > 0), from 2 earlier final boxes, at most 500, drafted = 0 (ranker.serving, as M3 sends)

verdict.rule: over >= 5 seeds: NDCG@10 model - repeat last week (holdout view), per-seed paired 95 % t-CI lower bound >= 0.05; Recall@|basket| reported, no target; top frequency, the extra arms and the serving view reported, not judged
